newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Promet buys stake in S.African developer.
newsitem.headline: Promet buys stake in S.African developer.

text.p: Malaysian maritime and engineering concern Promet Bhd said on Monday it acquired a 70 percent stake in South Africa's Fairoak Investment Holdings (Pvt) Ltd for 18.15 million rand ($4.1 million) in cash.
The stake in the township developer was purchased from Locifan Trust, Promet said in a statement.
Fairoak intends to develop a township covering about 145 hectares in South Africa.

Promet said its participation in the township development would enable it to secure the role of main contractor. The acquisition will be financed by internally generated funds and bank borrowings, it said.
-- Kuala Lumpur newsroom (603-206 2323) ($ = 4.445 South African Rand)
